deadline.value: Apply by January 1, 2027; review continues on a rolling basis afterwards but early applications are preferred.

app_fee.value: There is no application fee for the PhD program.
app_fee.quote: There is no application fee for the Ph.D. program.

fee_waiver.value: No fee is charged to PhD applicants, so no waiver is needed.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no application fee for the Ph.D. program.

gre_general.value: Submitting the general GRE is optional.
gre_general.quote: Applicants may optionally (but are not required to) submit scores for the Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) general exam.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject test scores are not required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE subject test scores are not required.

supervisor.value: Applications go to the department's admission committee; inquiries to individual faculty are not processed.
supervisor.quote: Information and inquiries directed to individual faculty members will not be processed.

funding.value: PhD students are fully supported by fellowships or research assistantships, including tuition and a monthly stipend.
funding.quote: Graduate students enrolled in the Ph.D. program are fully supported by graduate fellowships or research assistantships

entry_route.value: Apply directly to the PhD with either a bachelor's or a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants interested in pursuing a computer science Ph.D. should apply directly to the Ph.D. program if they have either a baccalaureate degree or a master's degree.

notes: The Data Science offerings at Rice (MDS, online MDS) are master's programs, so no datasci PhD record.
